title: Right to be Forgotten
content:
Under UK GDPR, you have the right to ask Eton Manor Running Club to erase your personal data — for example, removing your name or image from our website, our event results archive, or our news posts.

To make a request, please contact a committee member with:

- Your full name
- The specific page(s) or content you'd like removed
- Your email address, so we can confirm once your request has been actioned

We'll respond to your request within 30 days, in line with our data protection obligations.
